{
  "title": "BRD: Interactive 3D 'Solutions Showcase' Module",
  "full_brd_markdown": "# Business Requirements Document (BRD)

**Project Title:** Interactive 3D 'Solutions Showcase' Module
**Author:** Novostack BA
**Date:** October 26, 2023

---

### 1. Executive Summary

*   **Project:** To design, develop, and implement a new 'Solutions Showcase' module on the Novostack website.
*   **Problem Statement:** Based on market research, our website must evolve to meet the user experience standards of a high-end fintech platform. The current static presentation of our services fails to communicate our innovative edge, align with modern design trends like immersive 3D elements, and may result in lower user engagement and conversion rates.
*   **Proposed Solution:** This project will deliver a dynamic, interactive website module built with **Three.js**. This module will visually represent Novostack's core services in an engaging 3D space, guided by a vibrant color palette and accessible navigation. This solution directly addresses key market trends and is designed to significantly boost user engagement, brand perception, and lead generation.
*   **Business Impact:** This module is projected to increase high-quality lead conversions, improve key SEO metrics through enhanced engagement, and solidify Novostack's brand as an innovative and modern fintech provider.

### 2. Business Objectives & Success Metrics

| Objective ID | Business Objective                                                                    | Key Performance Indicator (KPI)                                                                                             |
|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| O1           | **Increase Lead Conversion:** Drive more qualified leads through a superior user experience. | Increase submission rate of the primary Call-to-Action (CTA) on the host page by **15%** within Q1 post-launch.              |
| O2           | **Enhance User Engagement:** Capture user attention and clearly communicate our value. | Increase the average time on page by **30%**. Achieve an interaction rate of over **50%** with the 3D module.               |
| O3           | **Strengthen Brand Positioning:** Position Novostack as a forward-thinking tech leader.  | Measure via post-launch brand sentiment analysis and feedback from new client intake surveys.                                 |
| O4           | **Improve SEO Performance:** Create a high-value, indexable asset on the website.      | Achieve a top 10 ranking for 3 new target keywords (to be defined by marketing) within 6 months of launch. Improve Core Web Vitals. |

### 3. Project Scope

**In-Scope:**
*   UI/UX design of a single, self-contained website module incorporating a vibrant, accessible color palette.
*   Development of an interactive 3D scene using the Three.js library.
*   Integration of clickable 'hotspots' on the 3D model that reveal informational pop-ups or text panels.
*   Implementation of clear and prominent CTA buttons (e.g., 'Request a Demo').
*   CMS integration to allow the marketing team to easily update all text content for A/B testing and SEO optimization.
*   Full responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices (with potential simplification for mobile).
*   Comprehensive SEO implementation including indexable text, proper heading structure, and a static fallback for crawlers.
*   Adherence to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

**Out-of-Scope:**
*   A full website redesign or re-platforming.
*   Creation of the 3D models and assets (to be provided by the Design team).
*   Keyword research and final copywriting (to be provided by the Marketing team).
*   Complex backend integrations beyond a standard API endpoint for the lead capture form.

### 4. Functional Requirements (User Stories)

*   **FS-01:** As a **potential client**, I want to interact with a 3D visualization of Novostack's services so that I can quickly and intuitively understand their complex offerings.
*   **FS-02:** As a **user**, I want to be able to click on specific parts of the 3D model to reveal concise, easy-to-understand information about that feature or service.
*   **FS-03:** As a **user**, I want to easily find and click a 'Request a Demo' or 'Learn More' button after exploring the 3D model, guiding me to the next step in the conversion funnel.
*   **FS-04:** As a **marketing manager**, I want the module's text descriptions and headlines to be easily editable through our CMS so I can perform A/B tests and optimize for new keywords.
*   **FS-05:** As a **user on a mobile device**, I want the 3D experience to be smooth and optimized for a smaller screen, or be presented with a clear, easy-to-navigate 2D alternative if my device cannot support the experience.

### 5. Non-Functional Requirements

*   **NFS-01 (Performance):** The module must not degrade the host page's Core Web Vitals. It must achieve a First Contentful Paint (FCP) of under 2.5 seconds. The 3D animation must maintain a consistent 60 frames per second (FPS) on standard modern hardware. A lightweight static fallback image must be displayed while the 3D assets are loading.
*   **NFS-02 (SEO):** All textual content within the module must be rendered in the DOM and be fully indexable by search engine crawlers. The module will use a proper heading hierarchy (e.g., H2, H3) and provide a `<noscript>` tag with a simplified, text-based summary for maximum crawlability.
*   **NFS-03 (Accessibility):** The module must be compliant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. This includes keyboard-only navigation for all interactive elements, sufficient color contrast for the vibrant palette, ARIA labels for non-textual controls, and descriptive text alternatives for the visual experience.
*   **NFS-04 (Compatibility):** The module must function correctly on the latest two versions of major browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Graceful degradation or a static fallback must be in place for older browsers or those without WebGL support.

### 6. Assumptions & Dependencies

*   **Assumptions:**
    *   The target audience has access to modern browsers and devices that support WebGL.
    *   A vibrant, accessible color palette will be finalized and provided by the Design team before development begins.
*   **Dependencies:**
    *   **Marketing Team:** Responsible for providing final, SEO-optimized copy for all headlines and descriptions, as well as defining target keywords.
    *   **Design Team:** Responsible for providing optimized 3D models (e.g., in `.glb` format) and any required textures or assets.
    *   **Backend Team:** Responsible for providing a stable API endpoint for the lead capture form.",
  "sprint_priority": "High"
}
